# Alex Ivy

> Open source tools for Claude Code by Alex Ivy.

## Projects

- [AutoMode](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/): a free Claude Code plugin that picks the model and the effort for each prompt. Full page list: [AutoMode llms.txt](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/llms.txt)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/mralexivy)
- [AutoMode docs](https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/docs/): the full AutoMode documentation. Index for assistants: https://mralexivy.github.io/AutoMode/llms.txt
